notes.title: Now includes a "Making Of Metal Dead" booklet
notes.content:
We have now included a bonus "Making Of Metal Dead" booklet detailing the story behind the game's production for all owners of Metal Dead on Steam! 

This short booklet goes back to Malcolm and Ronnie's humble beginnings, and is filled with concept art and commentary by the creators.

You can find this booklet by navigating to your Metal Dead installation folder (usually c:\Steam\SteamApps\common\MetalDead) where you'll find the file titled "The Making of Metal Dead.pdf".

notes.content:
Metal Dead is the perfect game for Halloween, filled to the brim with gore and zombies and ridiculous mayhem. Grab it now for 50% off!

Also, if you happen to be at PAX Australia this weekend, come and check out Metal Dead 2: Encore at the Walk Thru Walls Studios booth in the ANZ Indie Pavilion!

notes.title: Metal Dead: Encore at PAX Aus 2014
notes.content:
The heavy metal sequel, [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=160642305]Metal Dead: Encore[/url][/b] (due 2015) will be rocking [url=http://aus.paxsite.com/]PAX Australia[/url] this October over the Halloween weekend! Follow us on Twitter [b]@WTWStudios[/b] and on the [b][url=http://www.facebook.com/pages/Metal-Dead/245380968837265/]Metal Dead facebook page[/url][/b] for all the updates.

If you happen to be in the southern hemisphere, make sure to come along to our booth in the indie pavilion and check out some brutal new gameplay. The Walk Thru Walls team will be there to answer any and all questions about Malcolm and Ronnie's continuing adventure. We can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: Metal Dead released - 66% off for the first 6 days, 6 hours, 6 minutes
notes.content:
Metal Dead is now available on Steam! It's been a long, zombie-strewn road, but it's finally here, and just in time for Halloween.

For the first 6 days, 6 hours, and 6 minutes of release, Metal Dead will be discounted by 66% of its already insanely low price tag, so grab it quick!

notes.title: Metal Dead Steam Edition
notes.content:
UPDATE: The release has been delayed 'til October 6th - apologies for the wait! We ran into some problems with the Linux version, which we're working on fixing and will hopefully include it in an update very soon.

Walk Thru Walls Studios is proud to present [b]Metal Dead's[/b] premiere on Steam!

[b]Metal Dead[/b] now includes:
- Full Steam integration
- 13 Steam Achievements
- Metal Dead trading cards
- Linux support (to be added in an upcoming update)

We're looking forward to drenching you all in blood and gore on October 6th.
